notes.title: Footsteps Fixed.
notes.content:
Fixed the issue with footstep sounds. They will now work correctly, and the sound will vary depending on the surface being stepped on.

Additional adjustments to camera sensitivity and overall performance.

notes.title: Character Outfit Swap + More Fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280071/235cce4811b49b2330110e07c03f44e3d49081cd.png[/img]

You can now change your character’s outfit! This was a feature many players asked for, and it's finally here. Just head over to the wardrobe in the apartment to switch between outfits.

I also didn’t want to miss the chance to let you play as a couple of other characters—like Emily, and Selene (everyone’s favorite from my previous games). With this new option, you can play the entire campaign using different outfits or even a completely different character.

Fixed an issue where Player 2 wasn’t able to interact properly with certain objects.

Fixed a bug that caused some interactions to freeze or make movement feel unresponsive afterward.

General performance improvements.

Combat improvements.

Improved the aim accuracy of your AI companion.

And more bug fixes.

notes.title: Performance, Shooting and AI Improvements
notes.content:
Note: You may need to readjust your camera sensitivity settings after this update, as some internal changes might have affected how it feels.

After hearing the community and realizing that the game has serious performance issues on some devices, I want to start by apologizing and sincerely thanking everyone who reported these problems. I’ve been working hard to identify the cause, but as I mentioned before, while the game runs fine on some systems, it crashes or performs poorly on others. That said, I remain fully committed to fixing these issues and improving the game. If this update doesn’t completely resolve the problems, I hope to address them in upcoming patches.

General optimization improvements, with a stronger focus on co-op mode, where the most severe performance issues were found. Naturally, co-op requires more resources since two screens are rendered simultaneously. If you're trying this mode, I recommend limiting your frame rate or lowering your graphics settings for better performance. This update should improve the situation overall.

Fixed a bug with shooting accuracy that caused bullets to miss more often than they should. Aiming should now be much more accurate, and most shots will land near the center of the crosshair. The game still features a sensitivity system where movement reduces accuracy, but with this fix, shooting should feel more precise and reliable.

Improved AI behavior for both enemies and your companion. Previously, she would shoot at walls or fail to respond properly. However, it’s important to note that her AI was never intended to overpower enemies or carry the fight—she’s meant to assist as someone with limited combat experience. She helps, but she won’t do everything.

Other minor fixes and tweaks to ensure a smoother, more polished experience.

Once again, thank you all for your support. I’m committed to bringing more updates and improvements. If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please don’t hesitate to reach out—it's the only way I can keep making the game better.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where loading the autosave in the sewers would take you to the wrong location, preventing you from progressing.
-Fixed an issue where you could climb the pipes and leave the map boundaries, causing you to fall infinitely.
-Fixed collisions with some objects that allowed you to access inaccessible areas or blocked the correct path.
-Other tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Combat Improvements and Adjustments
notes.content:
Combat Improvements and Adjustments

After listening to community feedback, I made several tweaks and improvements to the combat system to make it feel smoother and more responsive.

Fixed an issue where the camera would stay zoomed in even when not aiming.

Removed the delay when switching weapons — now you can aim immediately after switching, making combat feel more fluid and responsive.

Fixed a bug that caused kicking and shooting to trigger at the same time when using two different inputs.

Adjusted enemy AI and fixed a bug that allowed them to knock you down through walls.

Other combat tweaks and improvements.

Fixed some issues where certain interactions wouldn’t work properly in co-op mode.
